items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: "When You and I Were Young, Maggie,"

ctx.x: "Darktown Strutters Ball," "When You and I Were Young, Maggie," "Beautiful Doll," "Midnight Choo-Choo Leaves for Alabam'," and, oh, I can't make head nor tails of all the different songs I sang.
Where did you learn all of thos?
